finalText:
All application call sites are migrated — only `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` still uses `db.query`, and that file is explicitly marked "do not edit" (vendored, overwritten on every upgrade), so it's correctly left alone as the deprecated `query` method still exists in `lib/db.js` for it to call.

Migrated 12 files (couponService, macroAdmin, refund, sla, returnService, shipment, session, supplier, variantAdmin, teamService, apiKeyAdmin, cohort) from `db.query(sql, params)` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the pattern already used in `user.js`.
